observed_mechanism: NominalTypeChecker._canonical fully materializes repeated alias-DAG branches as fresh TypeRef trees even though TypeRef is immutable and may safely share canonical subtrees.

grf.hypothesis: Per-canonicalization memoization of successfully canonicalized aliases can reuse immutable canonical TypeRef subtrees, changing representation from repeated tree materialization toward structural sharing without changing nominal alias meaning.
grf.counterhypothesis: Alias memoization leaks ancestry state across siblings or masks a contextual cycle, so the apparent resource win changes fail-closed alias-cycle semantics.
grf.falsifier: Production integration must preserve direct-cycle, parameter-wrapped-cycle and sibling-provenance controls, remain Python-stack-total, and pass the existing exact-head TypeRef gate plus a deterministic alias-DAG structural-sharing regression on the self-hosted Linux/X64 target.

unusual_experiment.shape: A18 -> Pair<A19,A19> recursively to Int, with the same alias referenced twice at every level
unusual_experiment.environment: ChatGPT Linux sandbox faithful standalone reconstruction of current _canonical mechanism; not accepted release/VPS evidence

candidate.mechanism: iterative per-call alias memo plus direct reuse of already-canonical frozen TypeRef subtrees; cycle-epoch prevents memo promotion of subtrees that observed an alias cycle

unusual_experiment.interpretation: The open CM-02 alias-DAG blocker is reproduced as representation/work duplication rather than a requirement of the current immutable TypeRef semantics. Structural sharing is a retained repair candidate, not yet production-verified.

canonicalization: keep active_aliases and explicit leave frames
on cache hit append the already-canonical TypeRef directly instead of traversing/rebuilding it
memoize aliases only after their full subtree finishes without a newly observed cycle
allow alias chains that terminate at a cached canonical subtree to inherit the same immutable result
candidate_patch_design.comparison_followup: Because structural sharing introduces DAGs intentionally, _same should track already-compared identity pairs so equality does not re-expand shared subgraphs exponentially.
candidate_patch_design.diagnostic_followup: _render_type_ref still expands the logical tree to text; diagnostic output-size bounding is a separate resource-hardening question and is not claimed solved here.
